'''Rrelbocco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], who lived on [[Genarius]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Rrelbocco worked as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] in the [[Raging Rancor Cantina]]. He spent most of his time there talking with customers or playing the game [[Ride the Raging Rancor]] and he was the only person ever to complete it.
